arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Goldenberg argued Section 1962 affects government prosecutions.
Mr. Katsas stated the Second Circuit extended RICO to foreign claims.
Mr. Frederick noted the EU sued for actions in the U.S.
Justice Breyer questioned the purpose of including foreign acts in RICO.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether civil RICO applies to foreign injuries. The European Community wants compensation for harm in Europe. RJR Nabisco wants the claim dismissed. The Second Circuit allowed the foreign claim. the sides that brought the case ask the Court to reverse that ruling.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the geographic reach of civil RICO. It determines whether foreign victims can sue in U.S. courts. It affects how companies face liability for global conduct. It shapes the balance between domestic and foreign legal claims.
